fact.text: Workday identifies Accenture’s advisory and implementation role in its completed finance deployment.
The 2022 case describes HCM, Adaptive Planning and Prism work. It is a historical delivery reference.
KPMG describes the company’s Workday talent and HR transformation.
The delivery leader reports HCM and recruitment go-live; Kainos’s FY26 report also names the customer.
Published HCM and Payroll delivery with subsequent enhancements. The case does not establish completed Finance or Student deployment.
KPMG describes a multi-year HR transformation and Workday implementation in Brisbane. The page does not date go-live or establish Workday Student delivery.
Workday names Starlight and Kainos together in its ANZ partner story. This page does not expose module scope or a go-live date.

lineages.title: Local roots, two acquisitions, a new practice build
lineages.reading: Company ownership travels along one path. Duane’s later appointment is a people move, not another acquisition.

lineages.title: Build, sell, then build in a different ecosystem
lineages.reading: The continuity is in the founders. Versor’s data/AI track record does not become a Workday delivery claim.

lineages.title: A regional practice assembled through named capabilities
lineages.reading: Payroll, Adaptive and local delivery appointments show how the practice is being assembled. They do not measure another firm’s losses.

lineages.title: A business built within an existing platform
lineages.reading: Parent affiliation, a practice launch and an internal promotion are distinct facts; none reveals individual equity ownership.

lineages.title: Specialist capability meets a new parent
lineages.reading: The acquisition changes ownership. Retention and local execution determine what the combination delivers.

lineages.title: An acquisition that preserves the specialist brand
lineages.reading: CloudRock and SuccessDay share ownership after January 2026. Their separate identities still explain who a customer works with and where experience sits.

lineages.title: The delivery business continues after a carve-out
lineages.reading: Strada carries the sold payroll and professional-services business. Alight remains a different company; old references need their business boundary preserved.
